citations.assessment: Rashi expressly distinguishes Zevid of Nehardea from unqualified Zevid.
Amemar says he recited the teaching before Zevid of Nehardea.
The scene concerns Amemar permitting Huna bar Natan to marry; the unexpressed subject of the final heard clause is the issue in Heilprin’s reading.
Kahana reviews the levirate-material ruling before Zevid of Nehardea.
The exact scene has Kahana before Zevid of Nehardea in the slave-status dispute.
Kahana quotes the teaching before Zevid of Nehardea in the categories-of-damage dispute.
Kahana reports the passage to Zevid of Nehardea in the discussion of theft penalties.
The charitable gift tradition gives Kahana speaking before Zevid of Nehardea.
Kahana says he presented the argument to Zevid of Nehardea.
The eulogy in Pum Nehara explicitly names Kahana and Zevid of Nehardea.
Heilprin gives the eight-year Pumbedita tenure for Zevid. The notice gives distinct death dates, and it does not itself settle which Zevid had the tenure.
